results.title: The Master of Many Worlds
results.overview: A dreamlike glimpse of a nightwatchman and his partner on their rounds.

results.title: My Girlfriend Turned Into a Worm
results.original_title: My Girlfriend Turned Into a Worm
results.overview: When his girlfriend inexplicably turns into a worm, Arthur builds her a miniature world in an attempt to process his grief.

results.title: The Final Episode
results.overview: A crazed fan obsessed with the popular show, The Horror Squad Podcast, sets out to make sure they stop ignoring his cries for attention and review his self-produced horror movie, or pitch him an idea that may save their lives.

results.title: Résonance
results.overview: Lily, a young actress, loses her grip on reality when she discovers that her neighbor looks exactly like her—feature for feature.

results.title: Teatres de Campanya_Interferència documentada: Trajecte audiovisual del primer rocam
results.original_title: Teatres de Campanya_Interferència documentada: Trajecte audiovisual del primer rocam
results.overview: A commission by Marc Salicrú to Jordi Boquet about the 3rd action at FiraTàrrega: an incursion by the Brigades of Popular Confusion before thousands. A city concert with over 350 participants (bands, firefighters, buses…) that shattered urban liturgy into a procession toward collective ecstasy.

results.title: Something Real
results.overview: What drives us to keep going in a world that grows increasingly hostile toward our existence every day? Squirm Gallery, a DIY music venue, finds a way forward in a rapidly gentrifying Denver.

results.title: On Queer Aging and Endings
results.overview: Filmed in their home in Norway, this intimate documentary follows conversations between trans physician and queer-rights advocate Esben Esther Pirelli Benestad and their partner Elsa Almås. As Esben Esther lives with cancer, they reflect on queer aging, love and mortality, and what it means to face an uncertain future together.

results.title: No Way to Escape
results.overview: Five years ago, Lei Ming acted rashly, resulting in the death of his mentor, Lian Ping, in an explosion. Guilt-ridden, he severs ties with his mentor's daughter, Lian Hui, and devotes all his efforts to solving the case in order to comfort the deceased.

results.title: Eye for an Eye
results.overview: A scavenger in a post-apocalyptic combine attempts to flea their tyrannical leader's control, but will her sister (their leader) let her

results.title: When The Birds Return
results.overview: In a world consumed by chaos, a young girl left to fend for herself sets out in search of her mother with the help of a strange neighbor. But there are mysteries that only chaos can reveal.

results.title: The Jianglong of Longkuo
results.overview: The whole town is waiting for the "flood dragon" to transform into a true dragon, yet no one realizes someone is waiting for a sacrifice! Rain pours relentlessly for seven days, and strange deaths occur one after another… Taoist Zhang Buping arrives in Longkou Town and discovers that every victim bears an ominous "Fallen Dragon Claw" mark. Is this the fulfillment of a thousand-year-old legend, or the perfect crime of killing in the name of a god?

results.title: Happy Days
results.overview: Claudia is a girl like many other 20-years-olds, torn between past and future loves, but she has a peculiarity. When feelings overwhelm her, when she get excited or angry, she turns into a creature with white wings, tusks and feline paws. Her story is about abuse and protection, about growing up, about change: but most of all, it is about finding the courage to show others who we really are, and about being ready to take this risk.

results.title: Spin Wars
results.overview: SoulCycle, Flywheel, Peloton — the billion-dollar boutique fitness revolution built on ambition, betrayal and toxic sweat. This high-energy documentary exposes the dark side of "mind, body, soul" culture with deliciously colorful insiders.

results.title: Lines of Riga
results.overview: A portrait of a modern city. Documented and artistically interpreted life in Riga unfolds over a single summer day. Dynamic shifts between three main characters – a food courier, a tram driver, and a young girl – reveal the inhabitants’ daily trajectories and interactions with the city. A mosaic of intermittent scenes highlights nuances often lost in everyday routines, capturing the rhythm of the city and its rich urban life beyond the limits of the story.

results.title: Three Years Gone
results.overview: Maria and her father, David, search for an exorcism to rid him of the demons he believes followed him back from the war. David, haunted by his past, kidnaps Maria from her mother, Veronica, who faces her inner battles.

results.title: Stem
results.overview: Inspired by a true scandal, a devoted female researcher risks everything to earn the approval of a world-renowned stem cell scientist only to uncover the dark secrets behind his miracle cure that promises to end human disability.

results.title: Outgrowth
results.overview: A young girl forms an unlikely bond with the disembodied hand beneath her bed.

results.title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
results.original_title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
results.overview: Lisa and Al Robertson, known from Duck Dynasty, fell hard and fast believing they had found a once-in-a-lifetime love. But betrayal and unspoken pain slowly fracture what they built together. When the truth comes to light, both must confront everything they thought they knew about love and loyalty — and decide if their marriage and faith are worth fighting for.

results.title: WOLF
results.overview: Tilda Swinton guides us through the life of British musician Patrick Wolf, weaving together archive, present-day and animation to illuminate a singular artistic journey.

results.title: The Name of Action
results.overview: A look at why Hamlet, a play that’s over 400 years old, holds a mirror up to society today. Filmed across four days of workshops with youth theatre groups across London: The Big House, Bush Theatre Young Companies, Centre 59, and Open Door.
